title: Confusing a semantic-model-only control with source data security
prompt: The retailer is creating a new analytical store. It needs folder-level protection, row filters on `Sales`, and column restrictions on `Employees`. What should the architect select before creating access rules?

options.text: A schema-enabled lakehouse with OneLake roles
options.why: Correct: OneLake security is defined for the relevant lakehouse objects; schema-enabled structure is the demonstrated and appropriate configuration.

options.text: Power BI RLS alone
options.why: Incorrect: Model-level rules do not define consistent access to the original lakehouse for other consumers.

options.text: A flat CSV-only Warehouse
options.why: Incorrect: A Warehouse is not the demonstrated OneLake role authoring surface for these lakehouse folders.

options.text: Workspace Contributor for every analyst
options.why: Incorrect: Contributors are privileged and can bypass the intended read restrictions.

explanation: Use a schema-enabled lakehouse and security roles, then validate actual data paths and engines.

title: Data-plane grant is not an item-level permission
prompt: An analyst belongs to the SalesRead OneLake role but gets access denied when opening the lakehouse. The role lists the correct tables. What is the missing prerequisite?

options.text: Turn off OneLake security
options.why: Incorrect: Disabling protection is not an access prerequisite.

options.text: Explicit Fabric Read permission on the item or appropriate Viewer access
options.why: Correct: A data role grant alone does not necessarily grant the item-level access needed to access the lakehouse.

options.text: Give the analyst Workspace Admin
options.why: Incorrect: The broad privilege defeats least privilege.

options.text: Change the role to ReadWrite
options.why: Incorrect: Write privilege is not needed for reading and would overgrant.

explanation: Grant appropriate item access and role membership as distinct layers; retest as the analyst.

options.why: Incorrect: Broad default grants can affect effective access.

options.why: Incorrect: This removes required access controls.

options.text: Allow documented propagation and cache delays; verify membership at the identity source and rerun tests
options.why: Correct: OneLake role and group-member changes can propagate on different timescales.

options.why: Incorrect: That would invalidate least-privilege testing.
